name: POST - Login (Negative - Invalid Password)
descriptionHtml:
Generated from cURL: curl -X POST http://{{base_url}}/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"username\": \"{{login_username}}\", \"password\": \"{{login_password}}\"}"

Request:

POST - http://api-server/login

raw 
  {
  "username": "user_km1ird",
  "password": "wrong_password_123"
}

Response:

401 - Unauthorized 

  {"message":"Authentication failed. Invalid credentials."}
